2025 World Series

The 2025 World Series was the championship series of Major League Baseball's 2025 season. The Los Angeles Dodgers, the National League champions, beat the Toronto Blue Jays, the American League champions, four games to three. It was the Dodgers' second title in a row: they had beaten the New York Yankees in 2024.

## Background

The Dodgers were the first team to win the World Series in consecutive seasons since the New York Yankees won three in a row from 1998 to 2000. The Blue Jays were in their first World Series since 1993, when they won their second title in a row.

## Summary

The series went the full seven games and ended in Toronto in early November 2025.

## Aftermath

The following season's World Series, in 2026, was won by the Milwaukee Brewers, who beat the Tampa Bay Rays four games to one for the first title in the franchise's history.

# 2025 World Series
URL: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2025_World_Series
Published: 2026-11-12

2025 World Series

The 2025 World Series was the championship series of Major League Baseball's 2025 season. The Los Angeles Dodgers, the National League champions, beat the Toronto Blue Jays, the American League champions, four games to three. It was the Dodgers' second title in a row: they had beaten the New York Yankees in 2024.

## Background

The Dodgers were the first team to win the World Series in consecutive seasons since the New York Yankees won three in a row from 1998 to 2000. The Blue Jays were in their first World Series since 1993, when they won their second title in a row.

## Summary

The series went the full seven games and ended in Toronto in early November 2025.

## Aftermath

The following season's World Series, in 2026, was won by the Milwaukee Brewers, who beat the Tampa Bay Rays four games to one for the first title in the franchise's history.
